cd /workspace && timeout 600 python3 - << 'EOF'
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import ipaddress, networkx as nx

# tiny-case overhead of network_simplex
G = nx.DiGraph()
G.add_edge('s','a',capacity=1,weight=0); G.add_edge('a','o',capacity=1,weight=5)
G.add_edge('o','t',capacity=1,weight=0)
G.add_node('s',demand=-1); G.add_node('t',demand=1)
for n in ('a','o'): G.nodes[n].setdefault('demand',0)
t=time.time()
for _ in range(200):
    G2 = G.copy()
    nx.min_cost_flow(G2, demand='demand', capacity='capacity', weight='weight')
print('tiny nx min_cost_flow avg: %.4fs' % ((time.time()-t)/200))

# staircase family (transportation worst-case-ish)
def staircase(n):
    G = nx.DiGraph()
    G.add_node('s', demand=-n); G.add_node('t', demand=n)
    for i in range(n):
        G.add_edge('s', ('r',i), capacity=1, weight=0)
        G.add_edge(('r',i), ('o',i), capacity=1, weight=0)
        G.add_edge(('o',i), 't', capacity=1, weight=0)
        if i+1 < n:
            G.add_edge(('r',i), ('o',i+1), capacity=1, weight=-(i+1)*1000)
    for v in G.nodes:
        G.nodes[v].setdefault('demand', 0)
    return G
for n in (200, 500, 1000):
    G = staircase(n)
    t=time.time()
    c, f = nx.network_simplex(G, demand='demand', capacity='capacity', weight='weight')
    print(f'staircase n={n}: cost={c} time={time.time()-t:.2f}s')

# random dense worst case with max_flow_min_cost API
rng = random.Random(7)
nreq, noff = 4096, 8192
pairs = set()
while len(pairs) < 262144:
    pairs.add((rng.randrange(nreq), rng.randrange(noff)))
G = nx.DiGraph()
G.add_node('@s', demand=0); G.add_node('@t', demand=0)
for i in range(4):
    G.add_edge('@s', ('rq',i), capacity=1024, weight=0)
for i in range(nreq):
    G.add_edge(('rq', rng.randrange(4)), ('r',i), capacity=1, weight=0)
for j in range(noff):
    G.add_edge(('o',j), ('oq', rng.randrange(4)), capacity=4096, weight=0)
for i in range(4):
    G.add_edge(('oq',i), '@t', capacity=4096, weight=0)
costs = [rng.randrange(0, 10**9) for _ in range(noff)]
for i, j in pairs:
    G.add_edge(('r',i), ('o',j), capacity=1, weight=costs[j])
print('built', G.number_of_edges())
t=time.time()
val, _ = nx.maximum_flow(G, '@s', '@t')
G.nodes['@s']['demand'] = -val; G.nodes['@t']['demand'] = val
for n in G.nodes: G.nodes[n].setdefault('demand', 0)
fl = nx.min_cost_flow(G, demand='demand', capacity='capacity', weight='weight')
cost = sum(fl[u][v]*G[u][v]['weight'] for u in fl for v in fl[u])
print(f'dense max: value={val} cost={cost} time={time.time()-t:.2f}s')
EOF
